title: A Personal Word
coreMove: Use the five languages as sincere care, not a shortcut: fill the love tank while still facing personality, history, honesty, wounds, and needed repair.

exampleSpecs.audience: Salma, a spouse trying to use service without ignoring old pain
exampleSpecs.stakes: A helpful act could heal or reopen a family-history bruise.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show personality, history, emotional baggage, and marriage shaping one love-language act.

exampleSpecs.audience: Diego, a married reader turning notes into a same-day practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: A good idea can remain theory unless it becomes one action at home.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Move from academic treatise to real time application.

exampleSpecs.audience: Gaelle, a mediator connecting private repair with family impact
exampleSpecs.stakes: The room has seen failed love become legal and family fallout.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Link stronger emotional love with divorce, families, failed love, and marriages.

exampleSpecs.audience: Murray, a spouse repairing a scorekeeping message
exampleSpecs.stakes: The right language could become manipulation if it carries a hidden bill.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show genuine love replacing leverage before the message is sent.

exampleSpecs.audience: Solene, a counselor adapting pace across couples
exampleSpecs.stakes: A shared exercise can comfort one marriage and overwhelm another.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use different personality, history, and emotional baggage to explain varied results.

exampleSpecs.audience: Farah, a group leader turning discussion into dated action
exampleSpecs.stakes: A thoughtful group can stay in commentary and miss the next loving move.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep married readers focused on real time application over academic treatise.
